description:
List Outreach calls with direction, outcome, notes, and linked call disposition. Example: { "prospect_id": "123" } or { "user_id": "601" }

Returns calls with state, direction (inbound/outbound), outcome (completed/no_answer),
answered/completed timestamps, notes, and the callDisposition_id linking to the
logged call outcome. Useful for meeting prep and reviewing recent activity.

page_offset.description: Record offset into the result list for pagination (maps to the API's page[offset]; e.g. 25 for the second page with limit 25)

prospect_id.description: Filter calls for a specific prospect

user_id.description: Filter calls made by a specific Outreach user

name: outreach_list_calls
